C0130.title: Shanghai Putuo Police Detain Woman for Fabricating Hotel Hygiene Claims
C0130.summary: In May 2025, China Police Daily reported that Shanghai Putuo police had solved a series of picking-quarrels-and-provoking-trouble cases. Suspect Wang used her allergic condition to fabricate hotel hygiene problems and demand room-fee refunds. Police found that she had stayed at more than ten Shanghai hotels in one month and repeatedly sought refunds on the same grounds. Wang was placed under criminal detention.

references.title: Shanghai Putuo police solve series of picking-quarrels cases; suspect detained
